entries.title: day 1 of learning and building in public.
entries.excerpt: so far i have seen multiple video on ai engineering roadmaps and have draw insights from reddit threads and chatgpt's answers, this is the final and best roadmap to become an ai engineer in 2027.
entries.body:
**AI ENGINEERING ROADMAP**

1.  **programming foundations:**\
   python, git, github, numpy and pandas\
   (expense tracker using python)
2. **machine learning foundations:**\
   ml concepts, supervised-unsupervised, regression, classification, model evaluation and basic statistics\
   (student performance prediction model)
3. **deep learning essentials:**\
   neural network, backpropagation, gradient descent, pytorch and training models
4. **llm engineering:**\
   tokens, embeddings, transformers, attention, gpt architecture, hugging face, llm api and prompt engineering
5. **rag:**\
   rag, vector database, document processing, retrieval, evaluation, tool calling and agent fundamentals
6. **backend deployments:**\
   fastapi, sql, docker, deployment, testing, monitoring and security basics
